caption: One image per class: the original, the preprocessed 128 by 256 image (CLAHE, resize, blur, black-hat) and the HOG picture computed from it, drawn with the project's own preprocessing and feature code. Images (numbered in the figure) are cropped and rescaled from: (1) Rahim et al. (2020), doi:10.3390/ma13122804, specimen B1b, CC BY 4.0; (2) Liu and Thermou (2024), doi:10.3390/ma17215227, specimen B-N, CC BY 4.0; (3) Hisbani et al. (2025), doi:10.1038/s41598-025-00146-8, specimen M4D6-P6, CC BY 4.0.
strings: Preprocessing makes cracks bright lines, and HOG records their direction in every 16-pixel cell.
